name: Article Business Generator
author: francescoiorio

sections.description:
Article Business Generator is a powerful tool that helps you create engaging content for your WordPress blog effortlessly. Using the incredibly fast and free Groq AI, you can generate well-structured articles on a wide variety of topics with just a few clicks.

This Lite version is perfect for bloggers, marketers, and site owners who want to keep their websites updated with fresh content without spending hours writing. The plugin interface is fully internationalized (translation-ready) and will automatically display in the language of the user’s WordPress dashboard.

Key Features in the Lite Version:

  • Powered by Groq: Leverages the blazing-fast Groq AI for instant article generation.
  • 50+ Article Topics: Choose from a huge, diverse list of inspirational topics, suitable for any niche (tech, wellness, travel, marketing, and more).
  • Daily Scheduling: Set the plugin to automatically generate one new article every day.
  • SEO-Friendly Content: The AI is instructed to create articles with proper HTML structure.
  • Save as Draft: All generated articles are saved as drafts, giving you full control to review and edit before publishing.
  • Translation Ready: The plugin interface is in English by default and ready to be translated into any language.

Upgrade to PRO! 🚀

Unlock the full potential of AI content creation. The PRO Version includes:

  • Multi-AI Provider Support: Switch between Groq, OpenAI (ChatGPT), and Google Gemini.
  • Advanced Scheduling: Set hourly, twice-daily, or weekly generation schedules.
  • Publish Immediately: Automatically publish articles without manual review.
  • Advanced Linking: Add up to 3 different authoritative external link sources.
  • And much more!

Get the PRO Version Now!

External Services

This plugin connects to the Groq API (https://groq.com/) to generate article content based on user-provided topics and keywords.

To function, it sends the topic, keywords, and other related settings defined by the user to the Groq servers for processing. This data is used solely for the purpose of generating the article.

You can review Groq’s terms of service and privacy policy here:
* Terms of Service: https://wow.groq.com/terms-of-use
* Privacy Policy: https://wow.groq.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the article-business-generator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Article Business Generator to configure it. You will need a free API key from Groq.
sections.faq:
Is it really free?

Yes, this Lite version is completely free. It uses the Groq API, which currently offers a very generous free tier. You just need to get your free API key from their website.

How do I get a Groq API key?

You can get your free API key in under a minute from the Groq Console.

Can I choose the language of the generated article?

Yes. You can specify the output language directly in the “AI Instructions” box in the settings (e.g., “Write an article in Spanish about…”). The plugin interface itself will automatically adapt to the language of your WordPress installation.
sections.changelog:
2.0

  • SECURITY: Refactored the entire plugin to use a unique prefix artbusgen_lite_ to prevent conflicts.
  • PERFORMANCE: Moved inline CSS to a separate stylesheet loaded via wp_enqueue_style.
  • COMPLIANCE: Added disclosure for the use of the external Groq API service.
  • FIX: Corrected contributors list to reflect the plugin owner’s WordPress.org username.
  • MAINTENANCE: Updated plugin headers and version number for new submission.

1.9

  • SECURITY FIX: Added nonce verification to the “Generate NOW” form to prevent potential CSRF vulnerabilities, passing all Plugin Check requirements.

1.8

  • SECURITY & COMPATIBILITY FIX: Hardened the plugin to meet all WordPress.org standards. Fixed all TextDomain mismatches, added sanitization for all settings.
  • CODE CLEANUP: Removed deprecated function call (load_plugin_textdomain) as per WordPress.org recommendations.

1.7

  • Corrected plugin header information for WordPress.org compliance.

1.6

  • Switched to English as the default language for an international audience.

1.5

  • Made the plugin fully translation-ready (internationalization).

1.2

  • Added daily scheduling for automated content creation.
  • Expanded the list of topics to 50+ for greater versatility.

1.0

  • Initial release.
